title: WorkspaceSpec
description: Passed to createWorkspace() (ADR-0003 §1). One workspace per run, not per node (ADR-0003 §7), held under an exclusive lease so two runs never share a checkout.

repositories.description: Repositories to be materialised. Multi-repository runs are supported, so this is a list rather than a single ref.

toolImage.description: Digest-pinned container image providing the workspace toolchain (ADR-0006 §5). A tag is not acceptable: the workspace must be reproducible.

leaseTtlMs.description: Exclusive lease duration. Expiry makes the workspace collectable; because workspace state is reconstructible (ADR-0003 §6), losing one is recoverable rather than fatal.
